We need to output only the corrected Java method with the same signature, no markdown. Identify bugs.

Potential issues: handling of backslashEscape, doublequoteEscape, singlequoteEscape: they may be null? but okay.

The switch case for '\0' should be escaped as "\\0" but in JS, \0 is null char; fine.

Potential bug: In default handling, when outputCharsetEncoder != null and canEncode(c) false, they call appendHexJavaScriptRepresentation(sb, c); but method overload expects (StringBuilder sb, char c) defined earlier. That's fine.

But maybe need to handle surrogate pairs for characters beyond BMP. The method currently processes char by char; for code points > 0xFFFF, need to handle surrogate pairs. Could be bug: should use code point handling and use appendHexJavaScriptRepresentation for code point, not char.

Also, the method currently appends opening quote before processing, and closing after. That's fine.

Potential bug: The case for '\0' should be escaped as "\\0" but if followed by digit, need to use "\\x00"? Not sure.

Maybe bug: The handling of backslashEscape, doublequoteEscape, singlequoteEscape should be based on quote char: only escape the quote that matches the surrounding quote, not both. But they always escape both double and single quotes regardless of quote param. Might be okay as they pass appropriate escapes.

But maybe bug: The method uses s.regionMatches(true, i + 1, END_SCRIPT, 0, END_SCRIPT.length()) but case-insensitive true; should be false? For </script detection case-insensitive? Usually script tag is case-insensitive, so true is okay.

Potential bug: The method doesn't increment i when it consumes extra characters for those patterns; but they only replace the '<' with "<\\", not consuming rest. That's fine.

Potential bug: The method doesn't handle characters that need escaping like '/'? Not required.

Maybe bug: The method uses outputCharsetEncoder.canEncode(c) but encoder may be stateful; need to reset? Not.

Probably the main bug is that appendHexJavaScriptRepresentation overloaded for int code point but they call char version; but char version may not exist? In class they have two overloads: one taking StringBuilder sb, char c; and one taking int codePoint, Appendable out. So char version exists.

But maybe they need to use the int version for surrogate pairs; char version only handles BMP.

Thus fix: iterate using code points: for (int i=0; i< s.length(); ) { int cp = s.codePointAt(i); ... handle cp; i += Character.charCount(cp); } and adjust cases accordingly. For cases that compare char values, need to cast to char only if cp <= 0xFFFF.

Simplify: Keep char loop but add handling for surrogate pairs: if Character.isHighSurrogate(c) && i+1 < s.length() && Character.isLowSurrogate(s.charAt(i+1)) then int codePoint = Character.toCodePoint(c, s.charAt(i+1)); then escape using appendHexJavaScriptRepresentation for codePoint (int version) and increment i extra.

Implement.

Also need to adjust default branch to use codePoint.
